name: m2a1_deny_item
_comment: M2a.1 deny scenario: defeat trigger bound to an objective -> Posture Deny. The relic cell (8,2) has the single entry node (7,2); the imperial wins the intercept race (1 MP vs 4 MP) and body-blocks the node (legal movement). Round 2: the scripted rebel grabs the relic; round 3 the threshold 'Item aufgenommen' deterministically flips the posture to Eliminate with a public log line.
